seo.title: Book an Appointment | Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kochi
seo.description: Request an appointment with a specialist at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), Kadavanthra, Kochi. Choose a doctor, a preferred date and time, and our appointment desk will confirm.

hero.lead: Choose a doctor and a preferred time. Our appointment desk will call you to confirm your slot.

labels.doctorHint: Not sure who to see? Leave this as “Any available doctor” and tell us your symptoms in the next steps.
labels.slotHint: Exact consultation times depend on the doctor's OPD schedule. We will confirm the time when we call.
labels.name: Patient's full name
labels.phoneHint: We will call or message this number to confirm.
labels.reasonPlaceholder: Symptoms, a previous diagnosis or anything the doctor should know
labels.consent: I agree that IGCH may contact me on this number about this appointment.

side.emergencyTitle: In an emergency, do not book
side.emergencyBody: For chest pain, breathlessness, injury or any medical emergency, come straight to the Emergency department or call us. Open 24 hours.
side.helpBody: The appointment desk can book for you, check a doctor's OPD days or help you choose the right specialist.
bring: Your insurance or CGHS card, if you have one
A list of the medicines you take

success.title: Thank you, we have your request
success.body: Our appointment desk will call you on {phone} to confirm the date and time. If the hospital supports it, you will also get the confirmation by SMS or WhatsApp.
success.note: Please keep this reference handy when you call or visit.
